Phase 14: Scenario C.2 (2025 EAT-Lancet) cuts added sugar far more sharply than the 2019 diet did (6g/day vs 31g/day), so the same proportional-extrapolation method used for B/C pushes honey's C.2 self-sufficiency to a striking ~2,795% -- not because honey production changes, but because the 2025 diet's much smaller sugar allowance shrinks the denominator dramatically. Read this as 'a diet that ate that little sugar would find Estonia's existing honey production trivially sufficient for its entire (much smaller) sweets allowance,' not as a claim about honey specifically improving.
